rules.rule: Only approved food-grade ingredient IDs with reviewed SKUs.
Hard exclusions and allergens override similarity score.
Check stock, glass capacity and administrator ethanol ceiling.
Carbonated ingredients are never shaken in a sealed shaker.
Unknown ABV, dosing units, dilution or nutrition never become zero.
Generated recipes need administrator review before guest ordering.
Reject fire, nonfood chemicals and unapproved concentrates.
LLM may select only current candidate IDs; amounts are recomputed.
Novelty and preference match are unvalidated indices, not taste guarantees.

note: Reference implementation currently encodes these bounds in code. Production must load and version this ruleset with migrations/tests.
